final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, race_count, CAST(race_count AS REAL) / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM city_counts) SELECT city, race_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, city
